CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   C. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Raising the Widow’s Son? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Raising the Widow’s Son.
   B. Say Raising the Widow’s Son has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Raising the Widow’s Son to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Raising the Widow’s Son with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.
   C. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Christian Moral Values: Purity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.
   B. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Judge Deborah has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.
   C. Say Healing the 10 Lepers has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Healing the 10 Lepers to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
